copyOverrides.en: Ask one clear question.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 先提出一个清楚的问题。

copyOverrides.en: Use this when a personal history is not needed to answer well.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 当问题不需要个人历史背景时，可以从这里直接开始。

copyOverrides.en: Start from the personal information you already know.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 从你已经知道的个人资料开始。

copyOverrides.en: Review the information first. Nothing is processed until you choose what to explore and confirm it.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 先查看资料；只有在你选择想探索的内容并确认后，才会开始处理。

copyOverrides.en: This first step is temporary. You can ask without creating an account or starting a longer journey.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 这一步是临时的。你可以先提问，不需要建立账户，也不会自动开始较长的旅程。

copyOverrides.en: Choose the starting point that best matches what you want to understand now.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 选择最符合你此刻想理解内容的入口。

title.en: See how the five volumes connect
title.zh-Hans: 看见五册知识如何彼此连接

caption.en: A single map connects the five-volume knowledge architecture without asking you to learn the system behind it.
caption.zh-Hans: 一张图连接五册知识架构，让你先看懂知识之间的关系，而不必先学习后台系统。

caption.en: Move from how reality forms to how it can be navigated and continued.
caption.zh-Hans: 从现实如何形成，一路走向现实如何被导航与持续。

title.en: From one question to grounded knowledge
title.zh-Hans: 从一个问题进入有依据的知识

caption.en: PHI OS keeps the answer connected to published knowledge and keeps unknowns visible when evidence is incomplete.
caption.zh-Hans: PHI OS 让答案保持连接已发布知识；当依据不足时，也会把仍未知的部分保留下来。

copyOverrides.en: A little more context
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 再补充一点背景

copyOverrides.en: When the situation is more complex
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 当情况比较复杂时

copyOverrides.en: I agree to carry this temporary context into a Reality Journey.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 我同意把这段临时背景带入 Reality Journey。

copyOverrides.en: You can start without an account
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 你可以不登录就开始

copyOverrides.en: Ask one question, use one follow-up and add temporary context if needed. Sign in only when you want saved history, saved results or continuity across visits.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 你可以先提一个问题、追问一次，并在需要时补充临时背景。只有当你想保存历史、结果或跨次继续时，才需要登录。

caption.en: Describe what changed, see how it formed, understand the current reality, choose a direction and return to review what changed.
caption.zh-Hans: 描述变化、看见形成过程、理解当前现实、选择方向，再回来回看发生了什么变化。

copyOverrides.en: Your journey
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 你的旅程

copyOverrides.en: Six clear tasks help you move from change to a reviewable next step.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 六个清楚的任务，帮助你从变化走向可以回看的下一步。

copyOverrides.en: You only need to focus on the task in front of you. More detailed processing stays in the background.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 你只需要专注眼前这一步；更细的处理会留在后台。

copyOverrides.en: Your choices and boundaries stay visible
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 你的选择与边界始终保持清楚

copyOverrides.en: If the situation needs urgent, regulated or professional help, PHI OS will stop the normal flow and point you toward the appropriate next step. Journey suggestions remain options you can review, not commands.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 如果情况需要紧急、受监管或专业协助，PHI OS 会停止一般流程，并引导你进入适合的下一步。Journey 中的建议始终是可以回看的选项，而不是命令。

title.zh-Hans: Reality Academy 如何组织学习

caption.en: Learning moves from understanding evidence to reading, navigation and continuity.
caption.zh-Hans: 学习从辨认证据开始，逐步进入阅读、导航与持续。

caption.en: Build capability step by step instead of collecting disconnected lessons.
caption.zh-Hans: 能力按阶段建立，而不是累积彼此断裂的课程。

caption.en: Books provide the knowledge architecture; Academy helps turn it into practice.
caption.zh-Hans: Books 提供知识架构，Academy 帮助把知识逐步变成可以实践的能力。

copyOverrides.en: Reality Academy
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: Reality Academy

copyOverrides.en: Learn to see how reality forms — and how to navigate what changes.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 学习看清现实如何形成，并理解变化之后可以如何继续。

copyOverrides.en: Use knowledge, examples and practice to build the ability to distinguish evidence, read a situation, choose a direction and review what changes over time.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 通过知识、案例与练习，逐步建立辨认证据、读取现实、选择方向并持续回看的能力。

copyOverrides.en: Five connected capabilities, from understanding to continuity.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 五项彼此连接的能力，从理解一路走向持续。

copyOverrides.en: Choose where you want to begin.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 选择你想从哪里开始。

copyOverrides.en: Start with the capability that matches what you want to understand or practise now.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 从最符合你此刻想理解或练习的能力开始。

caption.en: A lesson is one point in a longer learning path, not a one-time completion signal.
caption.zh-Hans: 一课只是持续学习路径中的一个节点，而不是一次性的完成标记。

title.en: Your personal reality is more than one result
title.zh-Hans: 个人现实不等于一个结果

caption.en: Personal information can be explored through different lenses while keeping each result separate from the whole of your lived reality.
caption.zh-Hans: 个人资料可以通过不同视角探索，但每一个结果都应与完整的生活现实保持区分。

copyOverrides.en: Personal Reality
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 个人现实

copyOverrides.en: Start with the information you already know.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 从你已经知道的资料开始。

copyOverrides.en: Enter your birth information once, choose the perspectives you want to explore, and confirm before anything is processed.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 填写一次出生资料，选择你想探索的视角，并在任何处理开始前明确确认。

copyOverrides.en: Nothing happens until you choose
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 只有在你选择之后才会开始

copyOverrides.en: Nothing is sent while you type. When you confirm, only the perspectives you selected are processed for this request.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 输入时不会发送资料。只有在你确认后，系统才会针对这一次请求处理你所选择的视角。

copyOverrides.en: Temporary processing · No automatic interpretation
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 临时处理 · 不自动替你解释

copyOverrides.en: Your information
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 你的资料

copyOverrides.en: What do you currently know?
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 你目前知道哪些资料？

copyOverrides.en: Choose what you want to explore
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 选择你想探索的内容

copyOverrides.en: I agree to process this information for the options I selected.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 我同意针对自己选择的项目处理这些资料。

copyOverrides.en: Review my information
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 检查我的资料

copyOverrides.en: Explore selected perspectives
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 开始探索已选择的视角

copyOverrides.en: Ready to continue
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 可以继续

copyOverrides.en: Your choices are checked before processing begins.
copyOverrides.zh-Hans: 处理开始前，系统会先确认你的选择与资料是否足够。

title.en: How professional guidance fits into PHI OS
title.zh-Hans: 专业协助如何进入 PHI OS

caption.en: Evidence, interpretation, professional responsibility and follow-up stay visibly separated throughout the service path.
caption.zh-Hans: 在专业服务路径中，证据、解释、专业责任与后续回看始终保持清楚区分。

title.zh-Hans: 专业判断始终属于人的责任

caption.en: PHI OS can organize evidence and support review, but accountable professional judgment remains attributable to the responsible professional.
caption.zh-Hans: PHI OS 可以整理证据并支持复核，但需要承担责任的专业判断仍然明确归属于负责的专业人员。

title.en: See financial reality as a connected system
title.zh-Hans: 把财务现实看成一个相互连接的系统

caption.en: Income, cash flow, assets, liabilities, protection, constraints and scenarios become clearer when viewed together.
caption.zh-Hans: 收入、现金流、资产、负债、保障、限制与情境放在一起看，财务现实才会更清楚。
